what: Finding 1: planned cancel render calls drop explicit repo forwarding
scenario_or_breakage: /design may be invoked with REPO bound to a non-default repository; render-final-summary.sh only upserts to that repo when --repo is supplied, otherwise tracking-issue-summary.sh falls back to hub/default and can update or fail against the wrong issue.
suggested_fix: Keep the existing ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"} on both driver-owned cancel render-final-summary.sh calls and add/update the structure pin so command-scoped render covers repo forwarding as well as ISSUE_NUMBER/SESSION_ID.
